title: Monthly equity, index and cash-settled currency options expiration — February 2028 (two sessions after the January 2028 FOMC minutes, one before the Washington's Birthday closure)
source: EST: RULE-DERIVED, and this entry states that rather than implying a published calendar exists. The standing convention -- monthly equity, index and cash-settled currency options expire on the THIRD FRIDAY of the month -- gives Friday 2028-02-18 (2028-02-01 is a Tuesday, computed from 2028-01-01 being a Saturday, so the Fridays are the 4th, 11th and 18th). VALIDATED AGAINST THE OCC'S OWN CALENDAR AND THE FAILURES ARE REPORTED: optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar, fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes), carries 36 'Monthly A.M. settled index options cease trading' rows spanning 2025-01-16 -> 2027-12-16 and STOPS THERE, 14 months short of this date. Each of those rows should be the third Friday minus one; the rule reproduces 32 of 36, and all four misses are holiday adjustments this session checked by name -- Good Friday 2025-04-18, and Juneteenth 2025-06-19, 2026-06-19 and observed 2027-06-18. FEBRUARY IS CLEAN IN THAT CHECK, 3-for-3 (2025-02-20, 2026-02-19, 2027-02-18), and February can carry no such adjustment because its only US market holiday, Washington's Birthday, is always a Monday -- confirmed for 2028 as 2028-02-21 on nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct today (HTTP 200 after 302, 109,180 bytes), whose 2028 column shows no other February closure and no early close. Filed estimate on the extrapolation past the OCC file's horizon and on this lane's standing no-self-confirm limit for an event discovered in-sweep. Promotion requires an OCC or exchange primary published closer to the date, not a recomputation of the rule. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the fomc-minutes-2028-02-16 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-09), at D+2 from that release, inside the +/-5 corridor -- which was otherwise COMPLETELY EMPTY across all 837 tracked events and proposals, this being the calendar's furthest-out researched print. Proposed for corridor completeness rather than as a finding: the proposing lane's positioning note is that in a February minutes week the dated flow events are the VIX settlement on the release day itself and this expiration two sessions later, so a reader of fomc-minutes-2028-02-16.md looking for what else is in the corridor currently finds nothing at all. THIS IS NOT A QUARTERLY -- the March 2028 quarterly expiration is 2028-03-17, which is also the anchor the proposed vix-expiration-2028-02-16 is computed 30 days back from. The impact tier is inherited, not measured: medium matches every other opex-* entry in this calendar. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED. symbols is empty and no house playbook (S1/S2/E1/S3/S4 + G1) is expiration-keyed; the proposing lane measured its own class against 4,949 sessions and found nothing, and nothing here reopens that. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
